data.name: CRIMSON
data.detailed_description:
Across a suburban town in the Midwestern United States, people have begun disappearing without a trace.

Evelyn Chandler, recently heart-broken woman, has to explore and fight her way though "The Church of The Bloodthirsty" alongside her sturdy chainsaw-pistol known as "The Bloody Mary" (put together by her friend Babe Manners). Before the sun rises again, she must make her way to the top to face off against Dracula himself and discovers why everyone has been disappearing. 

Try not to drown in the blood of the innocent as Evelyn and The Impaler go toe-to-toe in CRIMSON: THE GAME OF BLOOD

  • ANEXI ALESSANDRA is EVELYN CHANDLER

  • Cameron Crawford is COUNT DRACULA

  • Isaias Garcia is BABE MANNERS

  • Branden Floyd is VISCOUNT ALUCARD

  • Jay Gracia is TIM SLOAN

  • Michaela Laws is MOTHER STOKER

  • Isaac Pabon is [TO BE REVEALED]

with music by CRYOUT DE INIMA

and creature sounds by Sullivan Reed

CRIMSON is all about fast-paced, hack-and-slashing, chainsaw-slinging through waves and rooms of hellish enemies.

Evelyn can slide, run, block, saw, and dash. However, with the heavy chainsaws, she can't jump. Explore and fight through rooms and rooms of chaos and blood, bosses of untold horrors, and beat it all before the sun rises. If you die: it all starts again. 

Each chainsaw has unique modes of attack and abilities:

THE BLOOD MARY

Evelyn's tried-and-true chainsaw, Babe and Evelyn's first creation. Part chainsaw, part pistol. With seventeen shots per round, this fierce weapon is both sturdy in close combat and precise in long-range. Make sure to pull the ripcord to reload your pistol.

THE ANNIE SMOOTH

A light-weight, bar-less chainsaw with a handlebar attached that fires rapid nails as its primary fire, and launches a long chain that can be used as a grappling hook, whip, or a leash as its secondary fire. 

THE JACK-OFF

Evelyn's crack-baby of a chainsaw: loaded with a nitro engine for a faster blade and a boiling tank for blood, this chainsaw can and will spray a large wave of boiling blood to burn medium-range enemies. When killing enemies, blood will flow into the Jack-Off, instead of onto Evelyn: less blood-perks for Evelyn, more damage for your weapon.

THE PAMELA COSTELLO

Babe's brain child of a weapon. Straying away from the chainsaw norm, and instead combining a Sawzall and a shotgun to produce a grab-and-blast weapon that stakes a blade into the enemies as you blow them to pieces.

data.short_description: CRIMSON is a violent, gothic, roguelike, action-horror game all about a church arising out of Hell, and a heartbroken woman named Evelyn Chandler venturing inside to kill Count Dracula and his family. This is a blood-filled war out of love, revenge, and hunger.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i5-12500H
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3050
  • Storage: 64 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DTS X:Ultra Audio

content_descriptors.notes: CRIMSON deals with such topics as toxic romance, tragedy, sexual assault, religious psychosis, and depression. The game itself contains blood, violence, gore, slight nudity, horrific imagery, and religious horror.
